# BestPianoApp

> The independent, data-driven guide to piano learning apps. We synthesize 1,000+ public reviews (App Store, Google Play, Reddit, YouTube, expert sites) into one 0-10 MetaScore per app. Prices re-verified monthly. No sponsored rankings — no app can pay for a higher score.

## Start here
- [The 7 Best Piano Apps in 2026, Ranked by Data](https://bestpianoapp.com/best-piano-apps/): Full ranking with comparison table, pricing, and trial terms.
- [Find your piano app in 60 seconds](https://bestpianoapp.com/quiz/): 5-question quiz that recommends the right app.
- [How We Rate: The MetaScore Method](https://bestpianoapp.com/how-we-rate/): Data sources, weights, update cadence, and limitations.
- [Current deals and free trials](https://bestpianoapp.com/deals/): Active discounts and trial offers, refreshed monthly.
- [All piano app reviews](https://bestpianoapp.com/reviews/): Every app we track, in MetaScore order.
- [All comparisons](https://bestpianoapp.com/compare/): Every head-to-head matchup and alternatives page.

## App reviews
- [Simply Piano Review](https://bestpianoapp.com/simply-piano-review/): MetaScore 8.6. Course-style lessons, mic input, $169.90/yr.
- [Flowkey Review](https://bestpianoapp.com/flowkey-review/): MetaScore 8.9. Song-first learning, 1,500+ songs, mic or MIDI, $149.99/yr.
- [Skoove Review](https://bestpianoapp.com/skoove-review/): Real piano lessons with AI feedback, $149.99/yr.
- [Pianote Review](https://bestpianoapp.com/pianote-review/): Video lessons + community, premium tier $279/yr.
- [Playground Sessions Review](https://bestpianoapp.com/playground-sessions-review/): MIDI-focused with lifetime $349.99 option.
- [Piano Marvel Review](https://bestpianoapp.com/piano-marvel-review/): MIDI-focused, cheapest full-featured at $129.99/yr.
- [Yousician Review](https://bestpianoapp.com/yousician-review/): Multi-instrument, gamified, $139.99/yr.
- [Piano Tree Review](https://bestpianoapp.com/piano-tree-review/): Teaches music fundamentals, not just songs.
- [Piano Player Review](https://bestpianoapp.com/piano-player-review/): 3D real-hands view with motion-captured performances. $11.99/mo or $120/yr, 7-day trial. Featured launch partner; score provisional (7.5) pending broader public ratings.
